title: uleodendron ulei
intro: Uleodendron ulei, commonly known as the Ulei's tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rutaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Uleodendron ulei are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antioxidant activity, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include limonoids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to the plant's medicinal value.
